contract.publishers: Render_RunProgressivePaletteTransition and Render_RunPaletteTransitionFrom store their incoming A0 source pointer.
contract.readers: The same transition services read the pointer while applying palette convergence.
contract.source_shape: Each pointer identifies four contiguous 16-word palette bands at offsets 0x00, 0x20, 0x40, and 0x60.

conclusion: FF7DF2 is the shared palette-transition source pointer used by both transition implementations.
